'''Vortga the Hutt''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] lord. In [[684 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] traveled to [[Pybus]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] considered taboo by other Hutts, and established a [[Vortga's hidden complex|hidden complex]]. Many years later, he began to grow paranoid, and attempted to kill all of his former servants who had known about the base. Only [[Lalkan]] survived.<ref name="LoNH" />

Vortga was assassinated hundreds of years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After his death, many Hutts attempted to located his treasures.<ref name="LoNH" />
